dedupe_keys.name: smart tokenised multi agent motion model

description: SMART is the research authors' model for generating road-agent motion through next-token prediction. It converts vectorised maps and agent trajectories into discrete sequences and supplies preprocessing, training and evaluation code for Waymo Open Motion scenarios. Inputs are map and motion histories with model configuration; outputs are generated agent trajectories and evaluation scores. Coverage follows the selected driving dataset and scenario horizon, not a whole-city traffic inventory. Apache-2.0 source is free, with PyTorch, PyG and Lightning setup instructions. A limitation is that the README describes a future release of pretrained parameters, not establishing an immediately available checkpoint; Waymo data also has separate participation terms. Researchers can train the implementation to generate traffic for autonomous-driving simulations. Waymax (platform-waymax) provides a related road-agent simulation environment. The authors cite their NeurIPS 2024 work. No weights, driving data or model archive was downloaded.
inputs: Vectorised road maps and agent trajectory histories
